name: Caskmarket Vendor's Full Concealment Street Set
description: A deep-pocketed vendor's apron in weathered rust-brown canvas over a nondescript gray thermal hoodie, loose-fit cargo trousers with sewn-in flex-panel hidden compartments rated for 4kg of concealed goods, and scuffed platform market boots with false-sole storage. The apron's front panels are lined with signal-scatter fabric that masks the thermal signature of contraband. This looks like someone selling street food — and sometimes they are.
functionality: Signal-scatter apron panels mask thermal contraband signatures; false-sole boot compartments and flex-panel trouser pockets hold up to 4kg of concealed product across distributed load points.
what_it_says: This person sells things — the question is whether any of it is legal.
manufacturer: Self-assembled (components from Rolen Surplus and Dockwall street stalls)
story_hooks: The thermal-masking apron is also hiding a medical condition the wearer can't afford to have scanned at a checkpoint.
A regular customer hands over the wrong payment chip — it contains encrypted data worth more than anything the dealer has ever moved.
